x: For those who are are not 'au fait' with the team,the regular members are:- Jim Vivian,Chris Martin,Denis Gleeson and Clive Oliver. Other juniors who have had a good season are John Mitchell,John Martin, Phil Smith,Bob Nelson,Dave Nicklin and Adrian Major.
Our Junior relay squad - Oliver,Martin,Gleeson and Vivian - not only won both the County relays by the length of a street,but set new records in the process.
Ben Lulham's 'stable' was well to the forefront in the absence of Jim Vivian (appendicitis) both 100y and 220y were won by Chris Martin with Denis Gleeson and C.Oliver second and third in both races.
Gleeson and C. Oliver as members of the successful Junior Relay team mentioned above.

Please spare a thought though for our reserve, Clive Oliver, who would be the star of any normal team. Indeed it has been rumoured that at our present strength we could take on any two combined teams in an 8 x 110 yards race.
4 x 220 yards · C.Martin, C.Oliver, J.Vivian, D.Gleeson. · May 1965 · 1:32.4 secs.
